messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Garage estimates are misfiled and require manual recategorization, leading to missed evidence and delays.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real ... delays and oversight risks.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-11T14:49:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-23T09:05:00Z",
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5... Documents: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T11:36:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Also, the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads to incorrect file type issues.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.",
   "route": "support"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Garage estimates are misfiled and require manual recategorization, leading to missed evidence"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The evidence consistently describes a product defect: garage estimates are being auto-assigned to the wrong document category (correspondence) by the upload/classification system, forcing manual recategorization and causing missed evidence. Multiple quotes from support and account management (e.g., 2026-09-11, 2026-10-27) confirm this is a recurring in-product misclassification issue, not a pricing, contract, or customer IT problem. A rage-click session on document type (2026-09-23) corroborates user frustration with the product's document classification. No quote is praise, and no help article would resolve an automatic misclassification bug.", "verdict": "pass"}
